author: Murphh
body:
I believe it is a rule that you can not bow kill before the walls drop.  The time was 7:30 minutes into prep and the guy (Shortguy2158) on white shot me with his arrows and killed me on blue.  As you can see in the picture, the walls had not dropped yet.

If I am wrong about the rule, please let me know.
Thanks.
http://i.imgur.com/Jw7xrNU.png
